caption: The drawing depicts a single dark-colored ceramic cup with a distinctive thick, curved handle, set atop a matching, round shallow dish or saucer. The cup and saucer are rendered in shades of dark brown and black, with subtle highlights of white or light gray indicating reflections and the curvature of the surfaces. The composition is centered on the page with ample empty space surrounding the objects. The cup has a wide, rounded body with a slightly flared rim, and there is a small spout or notch on the rim. The handle is attached to the upper section of the cup, arching downward in a wave-like shape before connecting to the base near the saucer. Both the cup and saucer have a textured, almost woodgrain-like appearance due to visible brushstrokes or shading techniques used in the drawing. The background of the image is a plain, light beige or off-white color, free of additional objects or detail. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten signature.
